verdict.rationale: Luma's homepage says its 'Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text' and promotes 'Luma Skills' for reusable creative workflows, which suggests built-in agents users can delegate creative work to. The reasoning endpoint that accepts messy or chained prompts natively supports this somewhat. All of this is one-line marketing copy, with no docs on how a user actually delegates tasks to an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the in-product assistant and its delegation workflow, details of which tasks it can take on autonomously, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent feature.
